title: What stangent-fsd-reviewer returns (layer 5, D341; matches D366)
description: Every place the FSD and the code disagree, one finding per difference: a gap (the FSD describes what the code doesn't have), a conflict (the code does it differently) or undocumented (the code has it, the FSD leaves it out); and every FSD statement the code does as written, a match (D366). Code checks the section exists, every fsdQuote is word for word inside its section, and every evidence path (and line) exists at the reviewed commit.

section.description: The FSD section id the finding belongs to, exactly as in its heading's brackets; null only for an undocumented screen no section fits.

fsdQuote.description: For a gap, conflict or match: the FSD sentence(s) concerned, copied word for word from that section. For undocumented: null.

screen.description: For undocumented: the screen's full frontend route as the router resolves it, e.g. /orders/:orderId. Otherwise null.

note.description: One or two sentences: what differs, or for a match what the code does, naming the option, action or rule in plain words.

evidence.description: Code you read that backs the finding (for a match, the line(s) that do it): paths relative to the repo root with forward slashes, each with its line (path:line or path:from-to); a path alone for where a missing thing would be.
